selected_observable.observable: Cycle 1 day-0 tilt-corrected radial detector map at 58 instrumented assembly labels
selected_observable.caveat: The detector signal and assembly-integrated fission tally are related but not the same measurement operator. Per-position experimental uncertainty and normalization-induced covariance are not propagated by the current comparison.
selected_observable.rule: Do not compare non-equivalent observables or treat normalized detector signal as absolute power.

gates.name: Source and nuclear data provenance
gates.pass_condition: Pin upstream commit; record hashes, OpenMC version, nuclear-data library/version and provenance.
gates.remaining: Independently review all generated XML, nuclear-data state and actual transport inputs against the selected benchmark specification.

gates.name: Model-state fidelity
gates.pass_condition: Reproduce selected experimental cycle/state, geometry, loading, temperature, boron and control-rod state.
gates.remaining: The SE=230 override differs from the upstream default 228 and the axial step-width assumption needs sensitivity/geometry review. Actual loading and state fidelity need qualified independent review.

gates.name: Measurement-to-tally mapping
gates.pass_condition: Match detector channels/positions/response and documented uncertainty to the model observable.
gates.remaining: Assembly fission tally is not an exact detector response model; measurement uncertainty/covariance is not propagated. Do not choose rotations/reflections after examining correlations.

gates.name: OpenMC convergence and repeatability
gates.pass_condition: Independent seeds, source convergence, declared precision, raw statepoints/logs and hashes.
gates.remaining: Successful transport and integrity audit do not certify source stationarity or establish repeatability across independent seeds. A new expensive transport is not justified until the model/observable discrepancy is resolved and a protocol is frozen.

gates.name: Quantitative experiment comparison
gates.pass_condition: Frozen acceptance criteria and residual table with uncertainty treatment.
gates.remaining: Spatial agreement remains poor in both raw and tilt-corrected map diagnostics. The 95% Monte Carlo interval on the corrected run's k-effective includes unity, but criticality consistency alone cannot offset the poor spatial agreement or establish validation.

gates.name: Independent reproducibility audit
gates.pass_condition: Clean rerun reproduces the input-to-result chain and comparison artifacts.
gates.remaining: Recorded raw-statepoint and comparison checks passed integrity; independent clean rerun of the full input-to-result chain and scientific audit of the comparison operator remain open.

gates.name: CB-PFR candidate-effectiveness test
gates.pass_condition: Auditable physical candidate mapping; compare CB-PFR to baselines on same candidate pool and budget.
gates.remaining: BEAVRS model-to-measurement comparison does not itself measure CB-PFR ranking effectiveness. Keep the BEAVRS and six-layout C5G7 studies separate.

gates.name: Quantum execution evidence
gates.pass_condition: If claiming quantum-device execution/advantage, archive actual device/annealer runs and fair classical baselines.

explicit_nonclaims: The BEAVRS criticality consistency result is not a spatial validation pass.
A model run or green workflow is not validation without like-for-like experimental comparison.
Validating the BEAVRS model does not automatically validate CB-PFR candidate ranking.
The BEAVRS full-core candidate space is distinct from the six C5G7 UO2/MOX layouts.
QUBO formulation alone does not establish quantum hardware execution or quantum advantage.
No reactor safety, universal physical superiority, absolute power, or general reactor-design-method claim is supported.
